trigger: First review under RBM-005. Subject: the worked two-leg position in examples/arb/match-odds.json, whose legs settle under materially different abandonment rules. Chosen deliberately: a profile whose central gate is settlement equivalence should first be pointed at a position where the arithmetic looks like a lock and the prose does not, so a PASS would mean the gates do not work.
tier_rationale: A claimed position with real money at stake and two counterparties, which is Tier 2 under RBM-005 section 8. Tier 3 is not claimed: no odds source is configured, so AG-05 coverage is nought of five and the review cannot establish that a better price did not exist elsewhere.

omitted_roles.justification: AG-03 is the observation window, and both legs were typed from screens forty seconds apart with the gap recorded as evidence. There is no execution to audit: nothing was placed, no fill was attempted, and a seat reporting on execution quality would be reporting on an event that never happened.

AG-06 is registered as evidence stating plainly that prices cannot be re-observed and only the arithmetic over them reproduces. That is the whole reproducibility position for this review and it is on the record; a seat restating it would add a report rather than a finding.
